comments: Client-cert SAN suffix policy is implemented and enforced via the AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX env var, with config surface in config.go, enforcement in server.go (both at HTTP and TLS handshake), and deployment.yaml wires the env var.
Client-cert subject and serial audit logging is present on session.start in both CONNECT and WebSocket paths (logClientCertAudit and direct logging in session.start events).
TLS 1.2+, mTLS, and cipher suite restrictions are preserved in tls.Config (MinVersion, CipherSuites, ClientAuth, ClientCAs).
Deployment manifest includes the new env var with documentation and default empty value (no restriction).
